name: @kwpledger/swiss-deck
description: Builds the Swiss deck PowerPoint templates (presenting and 1080p video) from the tokens. Kept out of the root package so the design system stays dependency-free.

scripts.build: node build.js deck template && python3 post.py deck-template-raw.pptx Swiss-Deck-Template.potx && node build.js deck sample && python3 post.py deck-sample-raw.pptx Swiss-Deck-Sample.pptx && node build.js video template && python3 post.py video-template-raw.pptx Swiss-Deck-Video-Template.potx && node build.js video sample && python3 post.py video-sample-raw.pptx Swiss-Deck-Video-Sample.pptx
